name: Parker House Grand Manor Granada Library Wall with Executive Desk
description: Crafted of wood with birch veneers. Antique Vintage Walnut finish. Drop-front drawer / keyboard tray. 3 file drawers in bookcases. Includes 12 shelves. File and utility drawers in desk. Optional ladder extends 20.75 in. from bookcase face. Establish your home office as a sophisticated yet welcoming haven for planning, studying, and accomplishing your goals. The Parker House Grand Manor Granada Library Wall with Executive Desk features exquisite craftsmanship as revealed by the intricately carved moldings and cornices. With this set, you'll have plenty of desk space as well as ample storage space for books and office supplies. A pull-out keyboard tray and utility drawers keep supplies at your fingertips. File drawers can be found both in the desk and on the floor level of the bookcases and can be simply used for storage if your filing needs are modest. Beautiful birch veneers are set aglow with an antique vintage walnut finish. name: Elaine 1 Drawer Desk in White/Gold - Safavieh DSK2201A
description: Elaine 1 Drawer Desk in White/Gold - Safavieh DSK2201A An instant promotion for any office design, this contemporary 1-drawer desk brings style and substance to the workplace. Its sleek white finish is paired with a sculptural geometric frame finished in luxurious gold. Ample drawer space ensures organization. Dust regularly with a soft, dry cloth.
